g.text: Best valid cost: every paired task × replicate

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #25313c

g.text: Two synthetic tasks; two repeat/order IDs per task. Negative Δ is a lower operation count. Right labels show control → treatment.
† Open diamond: best valid prefix from the T/20b/r2 timeout; later decisions are censored.
No confidence intervals: repeats are not controlled model RNG seeds; this pilot has two tasks, not 40 independent tasks. Primary runs/v2 only.
